items.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation Complete Series
items.description:
The complete television series of Star Trek: The Next Generation, spanning all 7 seasons (178 episodes) broadcast from 1987 to 1994. 

Created by Gene Roddenberry, the series follows Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-D)
